speaker: Doctor
text: Did the mother report any rash, joint pain, or fever during her pregnancy or shortly after delivery? I also need to know if the baby has had any eye discharge or respiratory distress.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized erythematous maculopapular rash and pustules. I also have Rash with an erythematous base, Rash over the trunk and extremities, Sparing of the palms and soles.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST IMAGES

Given the mother's history of untreated gonorrhea and the presence of pustules on an erythematous base sparing the palms and soles, I suspect congenital syphilis.

REQUEST TEST: VDRL, Rapid Plasma Reagin, and Darkfield microscopy of the lesions.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the syphilis tests are negative, I need to reconsider other possibilities like early-onset sepsis or a viral infection.
